##  Run clusterProfiler
Run the test for all the pairwise comparison in group column for all the cell types in annotation column. The figures and statistical results with be saved in the `output_dir` 

```{r,include=FALSE,message=F,eval=FALSE}
start_time <- Sys.time()
```


```{r,eval=FALSE}
# Metadata condition column to perform the comparison
species <- "mouse"
run_clusterProfiler(seurat_obj = seurat_obj,
                    annotation_column = annotation_column,
                    group_column = group_column, 
                    output_dir = output_dir,
                    species = species,
                    n_jobs = 2)
```

```{r,include=FALSE,message=F,eval=FALSE}
end_time <- Sys.time()
duration <- round(end_time - start_time,digits = 1)
print(duration)
```

## Test Results Figures 
After running the clusterProfiler test, the following figures will be generated.

### GO_BP on all significant DE genes (Barplot, using top terms by p.adjust)
```{r, echo=FALSE,out.width="80%",out.height="80%"}
knitr::include_graphics("../../scDown_test/test/clusterprofiler/plots/GO_BP/GO_BP_ALL_top_20_Granule mature_35_vs_12_barplot.png")

```

### GO_BP on all significant DE genes (Dotplot, using top terms by p.adjust, then sorted by gene ratio)
```{r, echo=FALSE,out.width="80%",out.height="80%"}

```
